name: What does structural wall framing cost, and what makes it more expensive?

mainEntity.name: What does structural wall framing cost, and what makes it more expensive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on wall length, number of openings, whether the wall is load-bearing, and whether engineering or stamped repair plans are needed. In practice, more complex structural issues cost more because they involve design work, additional materials, and inspection-driven rework if the framing is not right the first time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs rise with load-bearing work, openings, engineering, and permit requirements. Simple framing is cheaper; structural changes with plans and inspections cost more.
